limitations.month_mean_fields_are_diagnostics: The month mean fields describe the spread of the monthly figures behind each cell and are not themselves estimates. A cell whose monthly means straddle zero has an interval that can reach zero; one whose monthly means share a sign does not, which is what the power flag records.
limitations.per_coin_cells_rest_on_few_months: A per-coin cell has no more months behind it than the pooled figure it sits under, and often fewer, so its interval is the weakest in the paper. 57 of the 96 testable cells sit on an interval that cannot reach zero, where the unanimity across months is the evidence rather than the interval.
limitations.a_quarter_of_cells_rest_on_too_few_effec: 26 of the 96 testable cells carry fewer than five effective months once the Kish count is taken on fill weight, which is below the point at which a cluster interval is worth reading. That is a separate problem from the 57 cells whose interval cannot reach zero, and the two overlap. Read the per-coin surface as a description of dispersion rather than as 96 tests.
limitations.nine_cells_returned_a_verdict_the_librar: Nine cells previously recorded a pass on an effective month count below the floor at which a cluster interval is worth reading. Those verdicts are now null, matching how the venue difference already handled the same situation, and verdict_is_available says which cells were testable at all.
limitations.the_t_interval_is_the_rebuilt_one: The t interval on each cell comes from the rebuild rather than the original measurement pipeline, which predates it. Its bounds therefore sit on a different random stream from the percentile interval beside them, though both rest on the same point estimate.
limitations.what_the_t_interval_would_change: Each cell carries both intervals, so the cost of the shipped percentile verdict can be read directly. Of the 70 cells that return a verdict, 60 clear zero on the percentile interval and 56 on the t interval. The four that differ are one on Binance and three on Hyperliquid; Bybit is unchanged at 26 of 26.
